verdicts.reason: A just shrinks the original's centered maroon panel into a tiny tile in the middle of the strip, so the headline, 'WE CREATE' and 'Join WADE team' are microscopic and unreadable, and most of the banner is just photo. B does rearrange things left to right and the headline is legible, but the maroon panel shrinks to a small block behind 'WE CREATE'. 'MARKETING FUTURE' half-straddles the panel edge and sits on the busy photo, 'Join WADE team' sits on the photo too with weak contrast, and the X/O decorations are gone, so it is clearly flawed but usable.
